[ASSISTANT_SAID] "Minari" cinematographer is Lachlan Milne, an Australian-born cinematographer.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lachlan Milne has received widespread critical acclaim and nominations for several awards, including the Academy Award for Best Cinematography.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Milne's cinematography in "Minari" is notable for its warm and intimate portrayal of the Korean-American experience.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Milne used a combination of 35mm film and digital cameras for "Minari."

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The color palette of "Minari" focuses on earthy tones and muted colors.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended resources for learning about cinematography include the American Society of Cinematographers (ASC) website, "The Cinematography Podcast," and "The Film Look."

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested exploring the work of Roger Deakins and Rachel Morrison.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Roger Deakins worked on films like "No Country for Old Men," "Skyfall," and "Blade Runner 2049."

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Rachel Morrison was the first woman nominated for an Academy Award for Best Cinematography for her work on "Mudbound."
